game.title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole
game.blurb: Comedy turn-based RPG in which the New Kid joins the town's superhero games, from Ubisoft San Francisco, released 2017-03-31. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "South Park: The Fractured But Whole" and for "South Park: The Fractured but Whole"). southpark.fandom.com answers the API, with about 21 linked pages, including subpages "Achievements", "Collectibles", "Missions" and "DLC"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 35 Steam achievements is hidden. No achievement names an add-on, so there is no DLC chapter. "Diabetes Defender" (defend a child from a drunk lunatic) was put in the main story, a guess; the Mastermind chapter holds only one achievement ("The Token Experience"). The Steam schema spells the name without the colon.
